title: Cassava Gnocchi with Creamy Sauce
description: A comforting and easy-to-make vegan dish featuring cassava gnocchi in a rich and creamy sauce.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the cassava pieces in a single layer.
Drizzle the olive oil over the cassava and toss to coat.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cassava is tender and lightly browned.
While the cassava is baking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the nutritional yeast and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Remove the cassava from the oven and let cool slightly.
Use a fork to mash the cassava in a large bowl until well broken down.
Add the cooked onion and garlic mixture to the mashed cassava and stir to combine.
Stir in the vegan cream cheese until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the gnocchi hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
